description: Defines the ExtendedDisplayIdentification class and related nested classes for handling EDID data, including parsing and extracting display information such as manufacturer, product code, serial number, color formats, and EDID extensions.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification
classes.description: Represents extended display identification data, including parsing and validation of EDID information, and nested classes for handling EDID buffers, iterators, and CEA extension data.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Buffer
classes.description: Manages a fixed-size buffer for EDID data, providing copy, assignment, and conversion operators.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over EDID extension segments, providing validation, reset, and navigation functionalities.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::CEA
classes.description: Handles CEA extension blocks within EDID, providing access to version, color formats, color depths, color spaces, timings, and other display capabilities.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::CEA::DataBlockIterator
classes.description: Iterates over data blocks within a CEA extension, allowing extraction of block type, OUI, size, and current data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the EDID data is valid based on specific header bytes.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Copies raw EDID data into provided buffer.

methods.name: Manufacturer
methods.description: Extracts the manufacturer code from EDID base data.

methods.name: ProductCode
methods.description: Retrieves the product code from EDID base data.

methods.name: Serial
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number from EDID base data.

methods.name: Week
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing week of the display.

methods.name: Year
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing year of the display.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version of the EDID.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version of the EDID.

methods.name: Digital
methods.description: Indicates if the display is digital based on EDID flags.

methods.name: BitsPerColor
methods.description: Returns bits per color supported by the display.

methods.name: ColorDepth
methods.description: Returns the color depth supported by the display.

methods.name: DisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type and supported color formats.

methods.name: VideoInterface
methods.description: Returns the video interface type.

methods.name: Extensions
methods.description: Returns an iterator over EDID extension segments.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the EDID data.

methods.name: Segments
methods.description: Returns the number of EDID segments.

methods.name: Segment
methods.description: Accesses a specific EDID segment buffer.

methods.name: CEASegment
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the CEA extension segment.

methods.name: WidthInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns the display width in centimeters.

methods.name: HeightInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns the display height in centimeters.

methods.name: PreferredWidthInPixels
methods.description: Returns the preferred display width in pixels.

methods.name: PreferredHeightInPixels
methods.description: Returns the preferred display height in pixels.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets EDID data to default state.
